source_clock.description: Source clock — typically 'CLOCK_REALTIME' for system clock. May be a PHC identifier (e.g., 'phc0').

dest_clock.description: Destination clock — typically 'CLOCK_REALTIME' (default) or 'phc0' to sync PHC to system. Leave empty to use default behavior.

domain.description: PTP domain number (0–127). If omitted, uses the domain from PTP messages or defaults to 0.

phc_device.description: Path to the PHC device (e.g., '/dev/ptp0'). Optional; auto-detected if omitted.

step_threshold.description: Maximum offset (seconds) before a clock step is allowed. Larger offsets cause immediate correction; smaller ones use gradual adjustment.

freq_range.description: Maximum frequency adjustment range in parts per billion (ppb). Limits how much the clock rate can be adjusted.

clock_identity.description: Unique 8-byte identifier (as hex string) for the PHC device. Required only when multiple PHC devices exist and disambiguation is needed.

log_level.description: Syslog verbosity level (0–7). Higher values produce more detailed logging. If omitted, minimal logging.

slave_only.description: If true, run in slave-only mode — do not act as master or respond to PTP messages as a master.

offset_samples.description: Number of PTP offset samples to average before adjusting the clock. Larger values smooth jitter but increase latency.

phc_timestamping.description: If true, use PHC-based timestamping instead of socket timestamping (requires kernel support and suitable NIC).

transport.description: PTP transport type: 'L2' (layer-2 Ethernet) or 'UDP' (IPv4/IPv6 over UDP). If omitted, defaults to 'L2'.

auto_switch.description: If true, automatically switch to alternate PHC source when current one becomes unavailable.

test_mode.description: If true, run in test mode — compute offsets but do not adjust the clock. Useful for validation.
